title: Practical Exam Preparation and Mock Practical Paper
lead: The capstone for the 26.10.2026 practical exam. Covers the exam workflow and rules of thumb, the full solution of last year's practical question (the cogni tester) in C and Arduino, an index of every exercise with where its solution is, and a full-length mock practical paper (three questions plus quick calculations) with complete solutions and a marking scheme. Everything in lessons 1 to 8 is used.
